headlines.title: C.H. Robinson to acquire RXO in US$5.8 billion deal
headlines.content_summary: C.H. Robinson has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire RXO in a stock-and-cash transaction valued at approximately US$5.8 billion, bringing together two major players in the North American third-party logistics market. headlines.title: Baltic dry bulk freight index hits six-week low
headlines.content_summary: The Baltic Exchange’s dry bulk freight index dropped to its lowest point in six weeks on Tuesday, pulled down by declining capesize rates. The main Baltic index, which monitors rates for capesize, panamax and supramax vessels, fell 68 points, or 2.2%, to 3,002 points. This marks the index’s weakest level since August 25. headlines.title: CJ대한통운, 전국 전통시장 박람회서 ‘현장 택배’ 운영…“사고 바로 집으로”
